purpose: Machine-readable rendering policy for Step 5 SVG footprints; no source coordinate overrides beyond explicitly cited R6/R5 derived geometry.

buildingTableSpecialRouting.rule: Sports surfaces and stands render in layer 10; sports buildings remain in layer 08. Records are not duplicated across layers.

outdoorSports.controlFootprintRule: Render controlFootprint exactly when present; rotationY defaults to 0 only when the R6 sports record omits rotationY.
outdoorSports.markerOnlyRule: If controlFootprint is absent, render only a center marker and count label; do not invent a field footprint.

hardRules: Do not choose 80m as a hidden fixed undergraduate dorm length.
Do not render HSP-02 at the obsolete independent ground parcel (-1280,-830).
Do not move Step 4 roads or water to accommodate buildings.
Do not invent control footprints for sports records that have only point coordinates.
